scope: P6 incoming call sound and global notification-sound mute
implemented: Real incoming ringing now checks both the incoming-call preference and the global notification-sound mute before creating an AudioContext.
Accept, reject, remote end and overlay unmount remove the incoming-call state and stop/close ringtone playback.
Notification settings expose a short incoming-call preview that uses the selected notification volume and is disabled while the call sound or global sound switch is off.
Message notifications already use the same global mute without overwriting the individual sound selections, so restoring global sound resumes the saved individual choices.

verification.command: vitest run IncomingCallOverlay, notificationPreferences and accountPreferenceConsumers

remaining_acceptance: Exercise incoming call accept, decline and remote cancellation with two real signed-in clients and an audible output device.
